response.sql: WITH mix_counts AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, COUNT(*) AS behavior_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), mix_shares AS (SELECT order_type_mix, behavior_count, CAST(behavior_count AS REAL) / SUM(behavior_count) OVER () AS share FROM mix_counts), with_baseline AS (SELECT order_type_mix, behavior_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS baseline_share FROM mix_shares) SELECT order_type_mix, behavior_count, share, share - baseline_share AS above_baseline FROM with_baseline WHERE share > baseline_share
